scoring_justification: DFT raw recomputation infeasible in lightweight verifier; paper-reported values used as gold with domain tolerances and trend checks.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported numeric and categorical results for BlueP/PN heterostructure.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and figures: HSE06 band gaps 2.64/1.86/1.3 eV, work functions 7.5/6.8 eV, ΔQ=0.0004 e, ΔV_H=7.99 eV, VBM=BlueP, CBM=PN, ΔG_H* 2.21/2.03/1.79 eV, direct gap true, optical enhancement true.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from paper sections: Fig. 3 (band gaps), Fig. 4 (work functions), Fig. 5 (ΔQ, ΔV_H), Fig. 6-7 (band alignment), Fig. 9 (HER), Fig. 10 (optical).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are taken directly from the paper's reported results and are the correct reference for reproduction.

bluep_band_gap_hse06.description: HSE06 band gap of monolayer BlueP (eV)

pn_band_gap_hse06.description: HSE06 band gap of monolayer PN (eV)

hetero_band_gap.description: HSE06 band gap of the BlueP/PN heterostructure (eV)

hetero_direct_gap.description: True if the heterostructure has a direct band gap, False if indirect

charge_transfer_delta_Q.description: Net transferred charge per unit cell from PN to BlueP (e)

potential_drop_delta_V_H.description: Built-in potential drop across the interface (eV)

vbm_layer.description: Layer where the valence band maximum is predominantly located

cbm_layer.description: Layer where the conduction band minimum is predominantly located

her_delta_G_bluep.description: Gibbs free energy of hydrogen adsorption on BlueP (eV)

her_delta_G_pn.description: Gibbs free energy of hydrogen adsorption on PN (eV)

her_delta_G_hetero.description: Gibbs free energy of hydrogen adsorption on the heterostructure (eV)

optical_absorption_enhancement.description: True if the heterostructure shows enhanced visible-light absorption compared to the sum of the individual layers

outputs.description: Aggregate results of DFT calculations for the BlueP/PN heterostructure, including band gaps, work functions, charge transfer, potential drop, band alignment, HER free energies, and optical absorption enhancement. The checker compares each field to the paper's reported values with domain-appropriate tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The scored artifact is the sole aggregate file; process steps must be genuinely executed to generate the required properties. Tolerances are designed to accept an independent re-run with a different open-source DFT code while rejecting random guesses.
